query:
SELECT id, name, family, chemicalFamily
FROM molecules
WHERE cas_number IS NULL AND pubchem_cid IS NULL AND smiles IS NULL AND inchi IS NULL AND inchi_key IS NULL AND coconut_id IS NULL
ORDER BY family, name
LIMIT 20;
